_comment: Primary coverage gate for the Core_Layer (src/core/**, src/data/**) at >=95% statements / >=90% branches. c8 check-coverage applies a single threshold set per invocation and cannot express two different per-layer gates from one flat config, so the Adapter_Layer gate (>=85% statements) lives in .c8rc.adapters.json. Task 8.2 runs the unit+property suite twice under c8 (once per config) so each layer is gated against its own thresholds; an unmet threshold exits non-zero and names the failing metric. The gate measures executable runtime modules only. src/extension.ts (composition root) and src/core/ports/** (type-only `export interface` port declarations that emit zero runtime JS) are excluded from the gated scope: both are evidenced behaviourally by the host harnesses, not by the gated metric. Because `all: true` instruments every non-excluded source file, the type-only ports must be excluded explicitly or they would report 0% and drag the aggregate below threshold despite having no runtime code to cover.
